sections.h2: Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil facilities rose from 3 a year to 138

chart.title: Each 12-month period has seen more strikes than the one before
chart.sub: Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil facilities per 12-month period, February to February.

sections.means: Strikes rose in every 12-month period, from 3 in the first year to 138 in 2025-26.

sections.h2: Ukrainian claims put Russian refining out of action at 42.74%, then more than 51%

chart.title: The later Ukrainian claim is more than 51%, against 42.74% in July
chart.sub: Share of Russian refining capacity disabled, as claimed by Ukrainian officials, %.

sections.means: Both figures are Ukrainian claims, and the post's own update says the later one has not been independently verified.
sections.todo: Label 51% as a Ukrainian estimate and date the 42.74% figure whenever either is quoted.

sections.h2: Two analysts put the 2026 counter-drone market between $2.47 and $9.17 billion

sections.means: The two firms agree on growth but disagree on size, so the growth rate is the more reliable signal than either dollar figure.
